title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1982-12-26
lineage: PCM -> Peak -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Superb cleaned‑up recording captures a mixed‑quality performance with occasional sparkle, highlighted by Phil’s debut on a six‑string bass.
ai_review.review: The sound on this set is praised as spectacularly clean and well‑processed, making the listening experience excellent despite an uneven performance that swings between mediocre and effervescent moments. Reviewers note a West Coast vibe and point out that it may be Phil Lesh’s first show using a six‑string bass, adding a historic footnote to the night.

ai_rating.rationale: Recording quality is consistently praised as excellent while show performance receives mixed comments; overall rating balances strong audio with an uneven musical showing.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers highlight the spectacularly superior recorded sound and post‑show cleanup, describing it as crisp and clean.

band_member_comments.Phil: Possibly his first show playing a six‑string bass, noted as a historic moment.
